I had to call corporate on them a few months ago, because there were a few cashiers that kept taking it upon themselves to scan the Kroger card they keep at their register, and I dont  play that, as Kroger is one of my http://www.upromise.com members and I get dividends when I shop, so dont try and steal my points because u dont want to ask me if I have a Kroger card, but I havent experienced this since calling corporate and then having the manger of the store call me and give me a $10 Kroger card for my troubles.Seafood dept closes at 7 or 8, but normally they have some fresh seafood in the refrigerated area once its closed.  Also, I have seen some plain clothes security guards yank some shoplifters outta this place on more than one occasion and there is normally an APD car parked outside.They even have one of those $1 DVD rentals cube avaliable now.

Anna was excellent today! She was quick to begin her cleaning tasks after we did a walk through my home! Anna is a great cleaner and I would have her back in my home any day! My home is sparkling clean!
They got back to me within a couple hours, and came out to my storage unit at a precise time I requested (no window). Prices were reasonable, and they were really quick! Thank you so much!
They only do natural nails but they do them so well. No machines just pure talent. The free drink is nice and the shop is nice and serene. The technicians are nice and good at what they do.
Good is consistent and this they certainly are. I noticed they do party trays also, good to know. The inside is traditional. The variety is what I truly appreciate

Stumbled upon this spot near the office that i am temporarily working and i will say that i enjoyed dining here. The place is a nice size so you can either be close to the crowd or have your privacy.. i prefer to be alone and have my space while dining so it worked out well. I dined from here a few times and i will say the food has some great flavor to it.. the staff is prompt and courteous. If you are looking to hang by the bar and watch the game w some apps and drinks, this spot can work as well. There is meter parking outside and i have never had an issue. ( i drive a pickup). I had the burger and was in love!!!  The chef actually listened when i said Medium.. I also had the rib eye which was also melted in my mouth.  Their price was very reasonable and easy on the pockets.... would of gave the extra star but unfortunately the manager never once took upon himself to walk around and greet his patrons. I know it may be a bit OCD of me but i think it shows how much he really cares about what he is doing...Def recommend to anyone is the area!

Certainly not what I expected. Time for a makeover at this hotel.  Room was large with a great view but also poorly lit with mostly  drab color everywhere. Windows were filthy. Furnishings were also a bit dated. Wifi was a challenging connection so finding things of local interest was especially tough as no guide to anything in the hotel or nearby could be found. Thank heavens for the Gideons. At least they did their job.  Hampton at least has an in-room guide that always tells me about the free breakfast, where I can get a pizza and other items of local interest. Our stay came with a free continental breakfast. We arrived at the restaurant reception desk and were NEVER seated. We had to find staff and we were told we could just sit anywhere. After we realized that the continental breakfast was little more than toast we opted for the up charge buffet only to find NO PLATES. We solved this by sticking our heads into the kitchen and taking some off of a cart. We filled our plates and had a seat. Halfway through our meal we were finally asked if we would like some coffee.  Coffee was good. The fact that we were so poorly treated at 10:00 AM on a Sunday is unacceptable. Like many downtown hotels this property is not cheap. Maybe it should be.

I spent three months research and searching for the perfect surprise engagement ring.   I started in south Austin and slowly worked my way northing and was growing frustrated from the lack of quality and dealing with aggravating sales persons.  At Benold's I meet Maria who was exceedingly patient and straight forwards with me (by this time I was starting to become jaded the moment I walked in).  She took the time to expanding my understanding of diamonds and rings, and went into detail on each ring we reviewed.   The experience was akin to the difference between dealing with car sales men verses dealing with the people who actually built the car.   I must have visited over a dozen times before the ring was in my hands - and every moment she was patient and engaged.    I cannot recommend her enough based on her character and expertise. My experience in general in Benold's was excellent.  I continue to visit and they have an admirable selection of quality items and the staff is exceptionally helpful.  I stepped in recently and casually inquired on how one determines the quality of several stones and pearls, and was very pleased at the length and detail which they went to inform me.  Five stars in my book, all the way.

Wish I could come here more often! It is consistently great - both service and food. One restaurant where you can't go wrong!  I would definitely recommend eating here! Be sure to make a reservation, even week nights are busy.
Good creative food in a fun atmosphere.Service is very friendly and attentive.

Great atmosphere, friendly staff, and very well kept. Not to mention FUNNEL CAKES! Could use a slightly bigger craft beer selection but this place is a great place to stop by early on Saturday, people watch and kick back.
Great Bar specials- 25 cent wings and 2.99 pizzas were very good...Bartender was very attentive and friendly,  I would definitely recommend this place for a good affordable lunch.
Always good and at a great price. Been eating here for years. Service is great, food is great, Mojitos are great. Why not five stars I don't know.

I'm already not the biggest fan of Bonchon, but my friend really loves the restaurant, so we decided to go while we were both in Salem. She ordered the bibimbap, while I ordered the pork buns. We also shared a dish of spicy rice cakes. The restaurant was relatively empty while we were there, but service was a bit slow. It took almost 30 minutes for all of our food to come out, and everything was spaced out, which was fine for us for the most part. The spicy rice cakes are okay. They're not amazing or memorable, but still good for a hungry appetite. The pork buns were not good, however. There was no flavor and it was literally a tiny piece of pork with a single cucumber. The buns were a bit soggy, and overall, I felt like I was chewing for way longer than necessary. If you go to Bonchon, stick with their chicken. The rest of their menu still can be improved and worked on, especially since almost nothing really had much flavor and portions were quite tiny for the price.
Both Zip lines were broken when we went; a fact they kept to themselves until after we had paid and gotten harnessed in. and they don't make it clear at all that there is a 60 minute time limit.

We needed a storage unit for 8 days, (reason: awful landlord) and these guys really saved the day! They were able to offer me  a promotion and made the moving in-and-out-process really easy. On our moving day, they came out right away to re-arrange trailers, so that our moving truck could get through. They were amazing, I would use them again.

This restaurant is a god send to the West End!  We have been there twice already and it has barely been open so that tells you a lot.  The food is excellent, we have tried the surf and turf (best steak I have ever had!!), lobster special, butternut squash soup, oysters and their filo mushroom appetizer and it has all been superb!!  Their service is excellent, as well as our waitress both owners (one of them the chef) have come over on both occasions to see how things are.  The decor is really nice, very comfortable and good atmosphere.  My mouth waters just writing this review ;)......

Every time we order online it gets screwed up and they almost never read the comments. I order a bowl with double steak (which costs extra) there isn't double steak. Today, we found orange slime in their ice machine which is disgusting. I understand the long wait due to people flooding them with orders but if I have to wait until 6:45 for my 6:15 order at least get it right!

Awesome people all around.  From the office staff to the drivers.  On time, careful with my belonging and accommodating!  I had a time crunch and a very low budget.  They listened to my instructions and just made everything so easy.  Thank you Move Drs, LLC.

I used to shop at the Santa Barbara, CA location and had done so for years until I moved to Simi Valley, CA. I then shopped at the Thousand Oaks location. This by far is one of my favorite chains. When comparing this location to the two California locations I'm used to, the atmosphere in this one was not as friendly or as inviting. They were out of stock on many items which is understandable because they opened a new location near the same vicinity.  Maybe this is why the staff weren't friendly, as moving is a real hassle. I plan to visit the new location. I'm optimistic that it will be a pleasant experience.

Coffee shops are all the same.  You come, you order, you sit, and you stew for hours on end sipping your choice of blend in caffeinated liquids.  They are all the same.  Strewn about with tables, chairs, plugs, your barista, and all in all, that's that.Enter Brother Moto.Not your hipter's coffee shop by any stretch of the imagination.  This place doubles as a motorcycle garage club as well as a Cabbagetown coffee join.Tucked away in Atlanta's Cabbagetown near the Old Fourth Ward off of Memorial Drive, blends everything motorcycle with everything coffee.  A fantastic marriage of both the smell of oil and Columbian beans from San Francisco.  There's always that hint that someone is working on a Harley while you sip on your latte.You need to come here and simply sit and stew.  It's a great spot to get away from your average everyday normal coffee joint.No...You don't need a motorcycle to come and be here.  Just your time, and if you don't mind looking at a classic Yamaha motorcycle while you're ferociously typing away on your laptop.I recommend the iced coffee...
This beauty supply store looks pretty dreary from the outside but it actually had some diamonds in the rough.  GOOD FOR: wholesale shampoo.

Making people beautiful ! What a classy salon with very professional Classy staff of ladies ! And of courts the Master himself , Franco !  I was treated ever so kindly and with the upmost professional scissors in Canada ! ( beside those of the master ) when the King is busy , let the Queen have her subjects ! Jyoti P. Was amazing ! As she worked her magic on my head of hair with precision unmatched back in the Arizona desert. Remarkable salon , beautifully lite and nicely furnished with modern comfortable surroundings.  The offer of a hot beverage when it's sun zero weather outside was certainly a warm welcome !  I was greeted. Quickly and assigned as a walk in immediately to Jyoti , who happened to have a cancelled appointment. To my benefit  ! I will return when back in Vancouver and you can certainly bet that I will talk to everyone I know of this epic beautiful WorkShop Salon @ 522 Beatty Street in Vancouver BC !

I LOVED IT!I have never been to Santouka and I probably won't go ever since I have Marutama right across the street. No lineups so we sat down right away, service was good, food came out fast, and it was bombbbbbbbb. Had the ramen with the soft boiled egg and it was AMAZING.Soft boiled egg was amazing I almost fainted (not an exaggeration) Do yourself a favour when you see that hella long santouka line and cross the street over to Marutama!!!!

We go here every once in a while as my hubby likes the Alfredo with crab.    On our most recent visit we brought some friends and we all ordered full meals.  We were enjoying all of the meal until we tasted the vegetables they were so OVER SALTED three of us couldn't even eat it.   We told our server and she apologized and went about the rest of the meal.   When paying $25+ for a meal and your veggies are not edible, just replace them or offer a free glass of wine or dessert.   Nope just the bill.   We wont be taking guests there anytime soon.

I live around the corner and this is my go to for out of town guests! Beautiful outdoor seating/entertainment in the summer.  Great for after dinner drinks in a relaxed atmosphere. Love that its located in a piece of Boston's history (old Boston Police Dept Headquarters) located inside the beautiful Loew's Hotel on Berkley St.

The food was great! People obviously come here for the meals.The Customer Service, great, too! Friendly, helpful. We were even offered a Senior Card for future discounts.Negative why I didn't like about the restaurant:1. Seats were taped up with duck tapes.2. Ceiling has holes in it.3. Cracked ceiling paint.4. Cobwebs.5. Toilets went on & on, no towels. no seat protector.6. Where my husband was sitting, a bullet hole in the window @ eye level.Badly in NEED of a remodel. Yes, I know, they opened in 1963, but I think it's time!

Must tries: the donut holes and the vegan cinnamon sugar donut.I've had a LOT of vegan donuts and Union Square's vegan cinnamon sugar donut is top tier (even for non-vegans). If you've ever had the pleasure of eating an Asian donut made with glutinous rice flour and enjoyed it, definitely go for it. So airy, fluffy, and chewy!

Walked in and an employee was sitting down feeding her face saying sit wherever you like.  We chose a seat inside. We were served our drinks pretty quick but it went down hill from there . Bottom line is the service and the food left alot to be desired.  The servers never came to check on us until we said excuse me mam.  When we expressed our concern to one of the servers her response was they have other customers.  Thought this was the same as the one on Sand Lake but I know now it is definitely not.  Asked for the owner and he wasn't there so they gave me a card.  Guess what, website on card doesn't exist.  Will never go back!  Awful!!

Great Food.  Reminded me of growing up in Guam when my dad was stationed there in the navy. Great service and high quality ingredients.  Pickled Papaya was a nice surprise and tasted just like the weekend markets on the island. Flavors are spot on with a good balance of heat. Portions are good.

My wife and I attempted to eat here last night before the Jim James show at Stubb's (BTW amazing show) but were very disappointed by the experience.  First the positives, this is the first time I have been down here since this property was Jaime's.  The re-design is beautiful and it looks like they have an fantastic patio to sip drinks and people watch.  However, this is where the warm fuzzies go away.  We arrived at around 6 PM and even though the patio was pretty busy the inside seemed dead.  We asked the host how long the wait would be and he stated 45 minutes for inside, as we were conferring to decide if we were going to wait he walked away.  As we were talking I looked into the restaurant and saw at least 3-5 empty tables and then as I walked around looked into a second room and saw literally 15-20 more empty tables.  When the host returned we asked about all the empty tables and he said he could not seat us because they did not want to overload the kitchen.  I'm sorry but a 45 minute wait to sit at one of your 20+ empty tables is not acceptable.  Best of luck but we will not be one of your patrons.

It used to be mostly a run-of-the-mill take out place, but since under a new mgmt, it has become quite good! I was pleasantly surprised! When ordering, the chef came out to not only answer questions but also make recommendations. I had a beef and eggplant dish as well as a catfish curry. Both were delicious and fresh, and surprisingly NOT full of salt (or sugar) like the previous proprietors used to prepare. If you've not given it a try, (it's on the high end of the price scale, especially for a take out place)! now would be a good time.

Great attentive service, generous portions, and tasty food.  I too no nothing about Colombian food, but what ever we got was great!!! The garlic sauce with the green plantain was powerful...burping garlic, but worth it.  It looks like they had a full bar and the place was very clean.It looked like the restaurant was about 75% full...but we were the only non Latin folks there.

Not a great experience and will not use them again.  Bought a Groupon so the price was good but beyond that, it was lackluster.They showed up 1.5 hours early without any prior warning so once they called I had to rush home from work.  The girl did an okay job on the kitchen and bathroom but brought her vacuum up and didn't even vacuum.  She mopped 1/2 the floor but not near the main door (which is right in the living room) where all the salt was so there were still huge salt stains from the winter.  The Groupon was also for a 3 hour cleaning and they only stayed 2.5 hours, which would have left them a 1/2 hour to vacuum, so it's not like she ran out of time.  Will not be using again.
Allison C's service was A1!  great place to hang out and grab a few drinks and socialize with a few friends. The atmosphere is especially great on the weekends when the live DJ is on

I was searching for car insurance for my daughter, a new resident of Portland who hadn't needed insurance for several years since she lived in Brooklyn. Ric checked out every carrier to get her a policy that wasn't incredibly expensive, and even worked a further discount to get her renter's insurance. His attention to detail, promptness and easy communication won him a customer for all future insurance needs! I highly recommend him and Consumers Choice Insurance.

Probably one of the most magical, beautiful and amazing places on this earth. If unicorns and rainbows could mate, La Taqueria would be their love child. Their tacos are one of the best in Vancouver. Having lived in Oregon, California and Washington, I've had a lot of good tacos in my life and it's been tough finding authentic ones up here in Vancouver (though it's getting better and better!) and La Taqueria is right up there with the best. Their staff is awesome and the guy who owns or manages it is hilarious, always friendly and extremely passionate about tacos. It's fun going to a place where you feel like they're a part of the neighborhood and treat what they do as a craft. Plus, I love their branding, decor and social media presence.

My husband and I dined at Pabu last night.We were here visiting for the weekend and wanted to try something new. Upon entering we were immediately welcomed  by an elegant yet warm ambiance that was lit by glowing lanterns.We tried several dishes from their wonderful menu and they all exceeded our expectations. Our favorite dishes were the tofu (so delicate) the chefs nigiri and the maitake tempura, and of course the happy spoon. The Pabu staff were extremely attentive, friendly and knowledgeable. Linchul and Conor made us feel right at home. Last but not least, we tried a few different sakes from their extensive program with help by their Sommelier, Mayu who gave us some fantastic recommendations. We can't wait to return.

i have to say that, like others, i thought this place was a bit questionable given the fact that it's located in a random shopping center down south. and the inside surely doesn't look like a typical austin tex-mex place, more like a mini-sports bar/restaurant that serves mexican food. though the chips were leaning toward staleness, their salsa was mmm mmm good and spicy. i ordered the chicken mole enchiladas and they were really tasty. this place also has good rice--i usually don't eat my rice because, to be honest, most mexican places around here don't have good rice. but this place does! their house rocks margaritas and blue margaritas are super deelish, and stronger than they taste (just trust me on this one). the waiter was excellent, very personable and attentive. overall a great experience, i'll be back!

I went to Barcelona on a Saturday night. Overall, I'd go back, but there were some service issues that left me giving this a 3 star when it could have been a 4 star review (food was good!).We had a reservation for 5 people at 9:30pm and were seated at 10. 30 mins late... and the bar was SO crowded that we felt like we were in the way the whole time we waited... No comped drink for the wait. Thank god we had a reservation b/c they were telling people it was a 2.5 hour wait when we showed up! Be forewarned, make a resi. The bar is giant, which is nice for the South End. It was packed, like NYC packed. We sat, and the tables are nice--not too close to each other, not too cramped. I'd say the majority of people were in their 30s, it wasn't a young crowd which was nice. It was a lively crowd. And it was nice to see a restaurant that wasn't all old white people sitting around with their chardonnay. This was a cool group.We had 2 waiters, we ordered water and they confirmed that we'd been to a tapas restaurant before. They came back with water and we ordered sangria for the table.Then we ordered food. Here's what we got:Shishito peppers-standard, pretty good.Gambas al ajillo / Shrimp with garlic-shrimp was slightly overcooked, but the garlic sauce was deliciousTruffle salad--one of the highlights of the dishes for me. Really good, slivers of black truffle, sweet apple, a whipped cream that I thought might have been whipped fromage blanc or something super mild, but it was really cream! It was surprisingly delicious.Whipped sheep's cheese--good, but not memorableChorizo with Fig--I didn't have this, but the table LOVED itBrussels sprouts--this was another highlight of the night for me, really delicious with a great spice--maybe harissa? So yummy and crispy. The top thing in my opinion.Short ribs--I didn't have any and didn't notice anyone talking about themMushrooms and herbed goat cheese--this was really good--nice vinegary kick.Paella--we got 1 serving of the seafood and 1 of the meat version. I liked the seafood version, but I think people preferred the meat version. The clams were slightly overcooked, but the crawfish was delicious, the rice was well done and had a bit of char in some places that was good.For 5 people, we had some leftover paella, but probably could have used another dish. The main issue was the service--we had 4 plates of food (and finished them) before our sangria arrived. I had to ask the guy filling the water glasses to go check on it for me. (We had the flora version of sangria--it was good, but not the best sangria I've ever had). Someone at the table ordered a coke and it literally came with the paella, which was the last thing to arrive. COME ON. That's ridiculous. They did give us churros to go at the end of the night, but we were all going in different directions, so it was kind of a lost gesture since they were packaged together.The waiter was loud which was nice is such a loud restaurant, he was nice. But I wish he'd checked on us between taking our order and things arriving. He also implied that we ordered too much for 5 people, when really, we probably could have ordered more and been happy.When I go again, I'll get that salad, the brussels sprouts, and the mushrooms, and then change it up and try new things. I'll also definitely make a reservation for the early side, and then call to see if it's looking like it will be later than planned.For sangria, wine, and the above dishes, it came to about $65 pp. Not too shabby!

I visited with my family last night.  Very AVERAGE Chinese food and service.Waitress was a small Chinese lady wearing glasses who provided very mediocre service throughout the process.  Tip was included, that is probably the reason why there was no effort on her part.Food, ordered various dishes dim sum to entrees.  Pork dumplings were deep fried versus pan fried, very greasy and filling was tasteless.  The best way to describe the orange chicken and other dishes is mall food court quality, if that.Hopefully, this review will help.

My boyfriend and I have been coming for Swahili at least once a month or something first few times it was really good, the past 3 times it has been an awful. The wait staff is rude, the main bar tender and the girl with pink hair, the foods gross and we will not be returning.

My brother and his wife were in town so I took them here as I've been wanting to experience this and for one reason or another I had not had the time to do it until yesterday. We all really enjoyed the experience. The price was reasonable and the air conditioned gondolas were very cool and comfortable. The views were extraordinary and we all thought the service was very welcoming and friendly. I would do it again!

So sad! Had meeting space rented with dinner. Food was just a bit warm sure not hot. They put tea out but no hot water. Room was very cold, we all had our coats on. One star because the room is clean and one because it's easy to find.

I'll be honest, I didn't really like my lunch, but it's not because it taste bad or anything. It just wasn't the type of lunch that I would like to have. It was mostly sandwich and wraps.I ordered the pepper bacon BLT. The taste was not bad. I like the taste of the chips. The bacon was crispy and kinda hard. Personally felt like it was kinda salty but still taste alright. Average customer service. I guess they deserve a five star because I don't thinks right to give them a lower rating just because the food is not my preferences.

After reading many positive reviews of Pho Oregon, I had high expectations that were disappointed on my first visit. The pho was good, but not remarkable. And the harshly lit interior was cluttered and dingy. Not everyone is as aesthetically sensitive, but I would gladly pay more to dine in more inspiring surroundings.If you're in the hood, it's worth a try. But there's no need to make a special pilgrimage to Pho Oregon.

I live in the Rollingwood/Westlake area and have been hauling my clothes to Tip Top Dry Cleaners at 12th/Lamar for about 8 years. They consistently did an outstanding job (dry cleaning on premise vs factory). Two years ago Tip Top was purchased by Reid's Cleaners and initially they kept track with Tip Top on quality so I moved to a location near my home on Bee Caves Rd.Quality of workmanship has become all too predictable. Laundered shirts with puckered collars and seams; dry cleaned items with easy to remove spots still visible; loss of structure in dry cleaned items, etc. etc.What prompted this review was my pick up two weeks ago of a wool Roxy coat (never dry cleaned, worn twice) that ruined the fabric and a Nordstrom purchased jacket/blazer that had the lining trailing behind it under the bag. The (very nice!) ladies in the Rollingwood store helped me remove the liner of the Nordstrom jacket with scissors. Aargh!When I looked at the other Roxy plum coat it was as if someone had rolled it around in lint and dog hair. It was utterly ruined. It was a gift for my daughter which weeks before had tags on it and had **never** been dry cleaned.  The poor, great guy at the Reid's location on Bee Caves Rd was very kind and said I would be called, and another woman helpfully told me I would *not* be charged for the DO-OVER on the ruined coat but was for the original destruction, which I had already paid. Nice.A man named Hector called twice but stick a fork in me. I'm done, and left searching for a quality dry cleaner in Austin.I have never, in 25 years of living I

These people are the absolute worst! All they had to do was deliver a mattress....the truck broke down and i was told by the dispatch lady that she had no info and would get back to me well several hours later still no word i call back and she says they are about to close and haven't heard from the guys so we have to reschedule and she didnt have any info still and to call back in the morning!....WTF

I just started working in Central Square several days/week and are exploring lunch options.  I'd walked past this place several times and finally stopped in for a bite.Service: nice enough...not amazing, but standard coffee shop style.  I do need to say that this is only for the front restaurant.Food: Yummy!  I had the veggie panini and it was delicious.  The bread was crisp and chewy.  The veggies were a perfect combination of flavor and texture that leads to a party in your mouth.My next goal for this location is to explore the market in the back.  Had a co-op market back in my hometown that I loved...and I'm hoping that this will be just as awesome!
Stop showing your damn commercials in Savannah nearest one is a hour away Damn i miss Atlanta

So I didn't want to highlight any stars because I'm giving this LOCATION ZERO STARS. I'd been told that the ice cream at JP Licks was SOOOOOO GOOOD BUT I will never end up being able to tell you if it is good or not because the customer service drove me away before I had a chance.I went in and got stared at by a rude young man behind the counter. When I then ordered the cake batter ice cream, he then very very rudely said we don't have any. He then proceeded to stare at me some more and didn't offer any suggestions or help. The way he told me they were out of cake batter was so rude, I could barely focus on ordering anything else. I then asked if they had the oreo cake batter. He replied very rudely that they didn't have that which prompted me to ask what they did in fact have available.He said everything else. So I then ordered the white coffee. He asked me if I'd had it before and I said no. He then TOLD ME I had to taste it before I ordered it. UHM EXCUSE ME!?! I'm the customer! I don't have to freaking taste it if I don't want to. BUT he didn't give me a choice. After tasting the ice cream, I told my boyfriend that we had to leave. The guy was so rude I will NEVER EVER go back to JP Licks. ALSO, my company is sponsoring a spin-a-thon for the Jimmy Fund and I had considered asking JP Licks to be one of our smaller sponsors which would have provided them with a good bit of free publicity. Now I DEFINITELY WON'T ask them to participate. I don't want a company with such bad customer service aligned with my company. INSTEAD I WILL ASK COLDSTONE to be a sponsor. YEP JP LICKS you lost FREE PUBLICITY and a chance to associate yourself with a good cause.
With change in ownership the food has gone downhill. It's terrible and I won't be back.

i went to the opening party for Bloomsberry Floral last night. What a charming little shop! It's full of potted plants, including some succulents in really cool cement planters. There are cut flowers too, and some fun hanging terrariums. There are also vases and some gifty items. The florist/owner was there and is very nice. I'm putting this new shop into my rotation of frequent visiting spots.

This is an awesome ice cream shop with an awesome staff. The place is clean and the ice cream and boba is superb. they even have a fruity pebbles flavor boba tea that one of the staff members created on accident! This place is a true experience. I've never had ice cream like this and the staff really know what they're doing. It's perfect every time! the flavors are awesome! the strawberry cheesecake is my favorite. They chop up fresh strawberries and a slice of cheese cake and put it in the ice cream! It's awesome! I usually don't get strawberry flavored ice cream because I'm not too keen on the artificial taste, but there is nothing artificial about this taste. its freshly chopped strawberries!! The shop is in an excellent location if you live in the west side of orlando or are on vacation at our local theme parks! Even if you do live a bit farther I would say it's well worth the trip. This place is also incredibly service dog friendly! they always make me and my service dog feel welcomed! I will never go to another ice cream shop again, and i am an avid twistee treat lover. I can't wait to try the food sometime!

This place had very good service and the food was good. Serving size was more then enough, had to take some home w me. The free internet was actually working and the surrounding was nice and relaxing. I could actually have a conversation with my guest and hear him. Overall enjoyed my lunch time today!

I think this restaurant is great! They have a huge menu with great prices. My mother loves their chicken sovlaki with cucumber sauce and their subs/grinders/hoagies (what have you) are phenomenal!  The food is quickly prepared and I am always completely satisfied when I leave.  The people that work there, I believe, are very nice. And their choice of decorating creates a fun atmosphere.  They have Americana artwork all over that is usually for sale and they have a variety of seating available.  Overall, I really enjoy eating at this restaurant and suggest it to anyone in the area.

Yummy restaurant in animal kingdom. Chicken tikka masala was very delicious... Plenty of spicy sauce and tender chicken! Lo mein with chicken and shrimp was enough for two kids to share. Passion fruit lemonade was worth it for kids.

Awesome idea with a warm and welcoming staff. This place is a really cute eatery that combines two great sweets: waffles and ice cream. They also add a fantastic sauce (try the lemon) and are fun to talk with. I didn't really like the winding layout of the restaurant and it would be nice if they had fountain drinks. Other than that well done!

The service here is top notch and everything we expect from a WDW experience. The food here is delicious! We had the lettuce cups to start, then followed by the chicken kabobs, and finally the dessert wontons. Everything was wonderful and we will come here again the next time we visit Animal Kingdom.
Food was awesome, only thing is , I wish it was served much hotter , some food was cold, other than that staff was wonderful and my food taste like heaven especially my jerk chicken , it was awesome

My first review. Yippy! Been coming here for quite a while. Usually carry out because of the noise level in the dining room. Noticed in the last six months or so that food quality is going down hill big time. We used to really enjoy it. Worse though is the wait time to pick up our order. Never ready when promised. Even worse, extreme attitude from hostess and cashiers. Actually, just plain rude. We are not complainers and I understand that people have an off day but we will no longer pay to be treated that way.

The snow had wrecked my break pads and rotors, I took it in to Midas since they were open on a Saturday one year or so ago and they replaced all the breaks and rotors for about 800.00, sounds somewhat reasonable for all that work. I needed it done asap, so it was the only place I could go at the moment since my regular Mechanic was closed for the weekend.And here I am, one year later, living in another state and having to REPLACE them because they were mounted wrong and therefore caused the same damage to happen again! All FOUR of them, another 750.00 to fix what they didn't do right.

I think that I have high standards for Indian food. This place was good, but not truly exceptional. Came here with a friend, and we ordered the two-person combo, which was a lot of food. We each probably took home a meal's worth of food - three people could share this without a problem.We started with soup - I had the coconut, which was really interesting, and some papadam.Then we got the main dishes, which included lamb curry and grilled chicken and beef. The chicken was a bit dry, but the curry was pretty good. The naan that came with it was tasty but unexceptional.I liked the service and decor. Fairly classy for a low-key Indian place. They also had the requisite Bollywood playing in the background.Came to like $30 plus tax and tip for the two of us.

This is a nice bakery located in a convenient location.  The cupcakes are the best I've ever tasted.  However, they're only available on the weekends.  And, the peach cobbler is also extremely tasty.  But, don't just take my word, stop by and try it for yourself.  They're celebrating their one year anniversary with a FREE dessert tasting on March 1, 2009 from 4-6.  Aslo, I read one review that indicated that $3.95 is expensive for a slice of cake, but try getting a slice for that price at Cafe Intermezzo.

I've gone here for several manicures and a few pedicures. It's a convenient location for me, and a cute place, but I'm never 100% impressed. The receptionist is great when you call to make an appointment, but once you get there, it's is a little lacking. Even if you are just getting a manicure, they make you sit in the pedicure chair and then turn to the side (awkwardly) while they do your nails. They have a few desks that look like might be made for doing manicures -- but the women who aren't working (on break or just not busy) sit there and use them as a place to check their phones. Granted, it's a small place, but I would think they'd want their employees using a private break room to hang out. I will say they've done a good job with my nails and are friendly. I just wish they'd use a manicure desk to avoid the uncomfortable body positioning if you're not getting a pedicure.

Both my husband and I are clients here.  He sees George and is very happy with him.  I see Donna and think she is great.  She listens and does exactly what I ask, and always has the best suggestions when I am unsure.  I get color, foils, cut and blow dry and she is very skilled at all of these.  The other hairdressers also seem great, although I have never personally seen any of them.  The salon is very clean and modern looking, and the location is good.

I had a dining room and living room set to donate. I spent money to rent a uhaul and drove the items to Saugus. The items were refused because they looked worn. The guy didn't even look at the dining room set at all which was used maybe a handful of times. He said they had too much merchandise in inventory and were refusing donations. I'm disappointed that I wasted money renting a truck to make a donation. Thankfully I found Savers who was very happy to accept the donation. I'll never attempt to donate to Sally's again.

Such a great nail salon! Everyone was so kind and welcoming. They really take their time with what they do--I got a pedicure and a manicure and they're both perfect. Great services for an amazing price. I'll definitely be coming back.

The absolute best place I have ever had my nails done. Very happy with my nails. They were very nice and helpful when helping me to decide what to do. Very clean, I will definately be going back and I highly reccommend this establishment to anyone!!!

While the food is good, I don't know if it is good enough to wait 2 hours in line for. The burgers are juicy to be sure and there are some creative takes with toppings, but the dining experience leaves something to be desired. All in all, Hopdoddy is good, but not mind blowing.
So good. The food is amazing. My kids love to feed the fish after dinner. Great family restaurant
I liked the sausages, the beer, and the vibe!Must try the humongous choux.

I come here every day for lunch during work and the staff has always been super friendly! Considering the kind of people they have to deal with that's saying something. The food is BK food so if you're looking for something fancy, you already know you're in the wrong place. But if you're looking for cheap fast food with a smile, this is the place! :) if I could rate them based solely off customer service I would give 5 stars for that. You can tell the employees are great people and they really care about those they serve.

I found a new place to do my nails in the New West downtown area.The location is convenient as it is just diagonally across from the New Westminster skytrain station, on the 8th Street and Carnavon side. Even though it was closed on Sunday, the owner took my appointment as she was opening the shop for another customer. While I was there on Sunday, there were a few people walking in, hoping to do their nails. In the end, the owner managed to get a staff in to help. I thought that was very accommodating of them to do that. Hopefully this place will open on Sunday on a regular basis. The owner who did my nails was very meticulous and insisted on fixing my broken toenail. One side of the nail was coming off and she said she would add powder (?) to seal it or something. The end result was a smooth nail and it took the polish nicely. As with most nail places now, there are massage chairs with the foot bath attached, and a common TV to entertain you. Or just bring a book and chill.

The prices left a bad taste in my mouth. I ordered one of the virgin drinks and ask for a little gin in it. I fully expected to pay more by adding alcohol. The virgin drink was $8 and they charged me TEN (!!!) additional to add the gin. This is highway robbery considering that the average price of the other cocktails on the menu was $14-$16. Very nice bar and the food looked great, but I can't bring myself to give them any more of my business after this experience.

Okay this hotel is not that bad!!! We arrived around 10am and got a text that our room was ready!! Awesome!!! We stayed in the 50s, 4th floor. Room was clean! Our bags came after a few hours in one piece, it was very convenient. At night, it was very quite!! We were in the parks all day so I can't comment on the pools or other amenities.

The Burren has very different personalities based on the night of the week you visit and whether you're in the front room or back room.  So, if you've tried it once and didn't like it, you should try again on a different night or make sure you spend time in each of the two rooms.  For example, on Fri & Sat, the backroom is usually host to a cover band with lots of college age patrons.  On Tuesday's, its open mike night in the back which is much more low key with often quite a bit of talent on display (along with some that are quite painful to watch).  The food is average pub fare, with both American and Irish favorites.  The beer selection is quite good, with many Irish beers and ciders offered.  The bar and wait staff is varied - I've had both wonderful and horrible (not attentive) service on differing nights.  But, this is all part of the personality of the Burren - its one of the few bars that actually has its own feel - not one that was manufactured and is being marketed to you (such as the Joshua Tree across the street from it).

L'hôtel est récemment rénové, les chambres propres ainsi que la douche. L'ensemble est très correct en rapport du tarif (voir note ci dessus) Par contre, malgré tout les avis sur le net,le petit déjeuner est exécrable ! !! Pain de mie et pancakes industriels, 3 grilles pains mis à disposition, pas de possibilité de prendre un copieux petit déjeuner type américain (pas d'oeufs, pas de bacon...) Autre abus je trouve, 5$ ajouté au tarif journalier annoncé sur la réservation de booking pour le ménage journalier et malgré cela, la femme de ménage met en évidence son enveloppe de tips tous les jours. Sur un séjour de 11 nuits cela fait vite grimper la note.

Yes. I am reviewing a place to eat at the Lloyd Center food court. I do consider my culinary taste above food courts. But... I love this place. It is nice to be able to find a healthy option to fuel my shopping energy. And I am not gonna lie... I have made a few trips here just to get some take out. What keeps me coming back? The BAO! The salad rolls are pretty decent too, and the dumplings, and the tea, and....

Sean's simple chicken and a warm cookie ice cream sandwich for dessert. Top notch. Chicken was tender and juicy and flavorful. Two warm chocolate chip cookies with a thick slice of vanilla ice cream and it's all covered with a chocolate syrup drizzle. Fo' shizzle my nizzle. Both plates were cleaned. Thoughtful menu with slightly elevated comfort foods executed very well. We've been here before and had great sandwiches. The atmosphere is always welcoming and inviting. We stayed here a few hours just talking to some regulars. Great times.

I had severe lower back pain,my Dr. suggested epidural injections, i was given three options to chose from, did my research and chose Dr. Anthony Lo Monaco. The first injection gave me the ability to sleep, the second brought my pain level from 8-9 to a 3-4.Had my third on May,18,2018 and confident this will allow me to resume all my outdoor activities.Strongly recommend!Bob N.Lynn, Ma.
This is my favorite food truck at the hitch! Always absolutely delicious, never dissatisfied.

Great selection of succulents and cacti of all sizes and everyone was very helpful when asked. They also sell arrangements and they're super unique. You can have your new succulents potted by them for a fee, I really enjoyed this place. Leashed dogs are welcome.

We've been here several times so knew that the food would be fairly good American-style Italian. Not real good - but fairly good. Tonight was much the same, but the service was poor. This was our first Friday visit and the place was hoppin' so maybe that's the issue. The line was slow, the order was wrong, the bread was way overdone, we had to go ask for cutlery. Our waiter never returned to the table one time after delivering the wrong order. It's decent food and a good price, but don't expect anyone to really care that you're there. Given that, I will still return - but not often.

MOLD EVERYWHERE!!! RUN! Walked in...lobby looks like a restaurant but a run down version....so..shitty. Staff was rude. Room  looked like a Motel 6. Small bathroom, room smells like farts, pillows felt like they were from the dollar store, no mini fridge, and walk ways on the 3rd floor feel like they are going to collapse (wood panels with carpet on top)!!  Don't believe the kid zone...its just a Walmart special. Not to mention you have the helicopter ride flys over every 20 minutes. Honestly, it was close to Epcot, CHEAP, and pool area was nice, which is why i am giving this 1 STAR ONLY. Besides that, negative 1 million stars.

Nice kitty kitty... The Mean Eyed Cat watering hole is a nice tucked away joint, not in the overall  mix of the 6th street gridlock of bars of Austin.... If your drinking here you gotta search it out before you belly up to the bar. This kinda reminds me of Uncle Bubba's place, because you feel at home instantly. The decor of THE MEAN EYES cat is something borrowed. I'd bet ya $20 that all this stuff was found on the side of the road or a yard sale.Kinda like drinking beer in the garage with a group of friends. That wonderful down home feeling helps ya all you toss a few brews back while you go into chill mode!

At 7p, I walked in for a haircut, as the call ahead list was booked. The receptionist told me they weren't accepting any other patrons for the night.They don't close until 8p.Receptionist didn't offer anything except to try the downtown location, which closed at 9p.

We went there for lunch on 1/16/2016. It was not good at all. It seems to me Red Lobster continues to serve poor quality food at not so reasonable prices. I ordered the blackened catfish with a ceasur salad and rice pilaf.The salad dressing tasted like it was just poured out of a bottle. The rice reminded me of a box of Rice a Roni....probably was. The catfish was ok but a very small filet. The other person ordered a seafood pizza. It was extremely salty. Told the server and he just says ...sorry....and walks away. I remember over the past years when RL was good. Now it's all about cutting corners to increase profits. Darden should just realize maybe it's time to close Red Lobsters and move on. They know there have been problems over the recent years. I will not be back based on another poor experience with RL...it's not worth it.

Good quality poke with a wide variety of toppings. The portions for each toppings is not as generous as Poke Guy on Richards Street, but still fair. I got the regular bowl with a mix of salad and brown rice with (2) scoops of poke and (5) toppings - total came to around $14.50 (including tip). Service is fast and friendly.

I went to the fair and rodeo for the first time this year. I went for a concert and the rodeo more so than the carnival. It is expensive but that is typical of a fair and no surprise. I had the fried taters and two soft drinks and both were good and overpriced. I had a good time watching the rodeo and the concert.
Found a huge bug in my salad. Halfway through the salad I discovered this bug. I almost threw up. I found the leg first, then found it's huge black body. Ugh!

I loved this place!! the sushi is so good! got something to go from here, so did not experience the service.. but food wise, the sushi is great! I wish they would deliver to the downtown area! Would definitely order from here more!
Friday night tasting menu + splitting a bottle with a buddy = awesome

I had been going to Corner Tandoori for quite some time as it's near my home and recently walking past I noticed it was under some serious constructions. KAZAAM! Now it's a more up scale Indian restaurant called Siddhartha's! I ordered for pick up there a couple of days ago and the girl gave me the low down after I walked in to a muchly renovated restaurant complete with giant art pieces on the wall. Now this place looks likes a nice spot to dine at and I will surely be going in sometime soon for a possible fancier date night. Same delicious food with a little bit of a price hike, but two of us can still get filled up for around $20. They are getting their liquor license soon and I guess that's when they'll see me for dine in ;) ;)

Ok, this place has changed hands (and reopened!) since I last left a review, and the food and ambience have definitely improved. The wait staff (a sweet, older lady) made us feel very welcome! The food arrived in a timely manner and was very good. Hubby had one of the specials, pulled pork sandwich on a bun. The fries were hand-cut, they slow-roast their own pork, BBQ sauce made in-house, and they made their own buns!  They also serve breakfast ALL DAY!  Talk about comfort food. I ordered the cheese omelet and extra cheese and the chef did not disappoint!  The hash browns were just right, and so was the buttermilk biscuit. Hubby really liked his pulled pork sandwich, he said it is spicy. He loves spicy food. Oh, and they have a Groupon, to boot!  Take advantage and come in and check them out!  A definite improvement!  I give it 5 stars!

Highly recommend Broadway Floral if you're looking for a local Portland florist! I've been on the receiving end of several floral arrangements from Broadway Floral for anniversaries and special occasions over the years. The most recent was in December of 2016 (pictured). Without fail the arrangements are always stunning. They don't look like the cookie-cutter flowers you often get from other places. The vases are usually packed and presented nicely - you can see the little decorative pebbles in the bottom of the arrangement in my photo.My husband says when he calls the floral designers are friendly, helpful, and good at making suggestions based on what you say you're looking for. And he says they're quick at delivery, I know sometimes he forgets to call until the last minute :)

Bought a groupon the evening before, so I could get an oil change before a long drive I had scheduled for the next day. I mentioned the groupon when I pulled up, and the attendant barked at me immediately, asking when I purchased it. He then tells me (loudly and rudely) that he cannot honor it until 24 hours has passed, and that I should have known that. I left and got a refund on the groupon. No way would I ever give them my business.

I had a great experience with these folks. My wife and I bought a house and quickly realized the previous owners hadn't ever vacuumed behind any of their furniture or cleaned the baseboards. Three very nice ladies came out and cleaned it all up. Only with a few days notice as well. The wood blinds, the carpets, all the hard surface floors, and the dusting. So much dust. I was also very satisfied with how clean the bathrooms were. I'll say I got more than I expected. A great value and friendly people. Highly recommend.

I have had Chicago-style hot dogs in many places, including Chicago, and Wholly Joe's, right here in Columbus, Ohio, has the best ones, believe it or not.  Among the places in town that serve them, no other place gets the components exactly right.  Some of them leave off the cucumber and some of them don't steam the buns and some of them chop up the ingredients.But the dogs at Wholly Joe's are things of perfection.  Something about the combination of the flavors... the burn of the peppers and the vinegar of the pickle and the sweetness of the relish... it all comes together so well.  Add in a high-quality hot dog with a great snap and you have the closest thing we mortals will get to ambrosia.Word is, Wholly Joe's also has great Italian beef sandwiches and pizza, but I wouldn't know; I stick to the dogs.  The fries are pretty good, even if it's obvious they're frozen.  Unfortunately, they no longer serve Pepsi and Mountain Dew in returnable glass bottles, but this is one of the few places that has both Pepsi and Coke.EDIT:  They now serve Mexican Coke in bottles.  Worth the price.  Looks like they've also replaced all the TVs with flatscreen models.  Can I give this place six stars?
Mike with repair was  unbelievably knowledgeable about my Gibson acoustic and what it needed.  He fixed everything and cleaned her up while I waited.  I am relieved that I found him.

5 for service, 5 for cocktails and 3.5 for food. Division Bell was a superb cocktail with Mezcal, Maraschino, Aperol and lime juice balancing very well. Food was mixed: plate of tasty olives; charcuterie was tender chicken ballontine; wonderful buttery mussels; bland octopus; slightly tough sirloin steak with not quite enough Bearnaise; interesting lobster bolognese. Service was excellent. Reasonable prices especially for the cocktails ($8-9). Definitely would go back.
Best Mexican food I have ever eaten by far. Absolutely delicious. Everything was authentic. The personal working we're very nice as well. Highly recommended this place.

In Boston for work for a few days. Always seeking the best oyster experience. Got a seat at the bar, that's in the kitchen of this smaller space. Bartender/waiter was friendly and attentive. As a wanna-be chef the kitchen was super entertaining. One cook did keep picking his nose which I didn't need to see. Just kidding. Ordered a dozen mixed oysters. All fresh and fantastic. Massachusetts and Washington offerings. Again, super fresh. At the suggestion of the staff, had the lobster roll entree. Served with fresh frites, cole slaw and pickle chips. All great. I lived in Massachusetts, married to a Cape Codder, for many years so  I'm a lobster roll snob. This wasn't the biggest, but definitely one of the best I've had. Topped it off with the chocolate mousse. Topped with Heath Bar crunch, sea salt and a drizzle of what I think was olive oil. Went down fast. Excellent. Everyone else was eating the carrot cake. Both served in glass pots. Or is ramekin the term? They were all moaning with pleasure, so I'd say eat one of those too. Overall, I'd go back.

One of my missions in bahston was to go to fenway, check.... and to find the best chawdah in boston. As we searched and tried every place known that has chowder from white to red we ultimatley found that warrens is the best in boston!This just goest to tell you that the locals know what there talking about and not to be shy and just ask. Sure legal seafoods puts up a good cup on a daily basis but you wont get the feeling with a cold beer and the atmosphere of warrens.. the chowder is really good, its more of a creamy soup with a hint of spice. Awesome chowder, awesome bar, and good people!Buon Appetit

What a great place to get froyo on a summer day, or any day for a matter of fact. Who cares of it's the middle of winter. Lots of flavors, but most are more traditional, stuff like chocolate, coffee, vanilla, and other fruit like flavors. I won't list them, but I'll say they let you try a flavor if you want to know what you are getting. Just don't sample everything in the store, the otherwise nice staff might not be super happy with you.They have very many toppings, fruit, berry, candy, and gelatin based. As well as liquid ones to go on top of everything else. Beware some of the gelatin based ones like Jelly Beans, gummy bears/worm turn hard as rock when placed in ice cold froyo.However, there are few reasons this place is short a star. First, I wish there were a tiny bit more toppings. There already are quite a few, but I can imagine you could add some more simple fruity ones, and some more creative onesSecond, I wish the dispensers did not dispense so much at a time, and dispensed it a little colder, and it seems to melt too soon.Third, it seems like this place is a bargain, but it adds up quick!

While trying to decide which food truck to get some lunch from I noticed a long line and thought they must be good to have that kind of line.  So, I got in line when I was almost to the window I discovered it was vegetarian.  I didn't want to go stand in another line so I said what the heck I will try it.  Was I pleasantly surprised for $5 I got a whole bowl of yumminess.
Agree with the others here that De Bens is a great classic barber shop.  Whenever I go in (appointment or not), I haven't had to wait or anything.  TJ does a really good job cutting my hair.

It was a little spendy, and typically I would've felt a little out of place somewhere so fancy feeling. But I felt right at home and the food was worth every dime. I highly reccomend the portobello, spinach, artichoke omelet.

I was planning on staying here due to the close proximity of the two best venues in Austin to check out music. The Mohawk and Stubbs.  The Mohawk is probably the best venue it's size in the country.  The management of this hotel is complaining about the best part of the hotel which is it's proximity to the best music venues to the city council.  Those venues were around a lot longer than your hotel.  Don't see the apartments across the street complaining and they have been there a lot longer.  I will no longer frequent here or the Westin due to the management of each hotel complaining about the best reason to stay at each place.  They should have spent more money on soundproofing if they thought the music would affect how much business they would get.

My boyfriend brought me here for my birthday dinner and we both walked out very satisfied! He did the research and told me that people rave over their sweet potatoe fries and drinks so we naturally had to get both. The fries live up to the hype! They came out fresh and crispy and the sirachamayo sauce was DELICIOUS!! I ordered a pineapple drop which was very good as well. My boyfriend isn't big on drinking but he was amazed by the drink, which really says a lot. The entrees we got were both super good as well, I got some sort of steak and he got the halibut (special of the day). Not only is the food good but the atmosphere is perfect for a night out with the girls or a date with your significant other.
This is my new go-to Thai place. Not only is the food delicious, no matter what I order, they are SO NICE! We've had excellent meals whether at the restaurant or take home! YUM!!

I went in today on the advice of you Yelpers, and I was very satisfied with the service.  The man was very friendly and helpful, and we had a nice discussion about Yelp!  The store pays attention to its reviews and tries to fix what is deemed lacking.  I found some nice yarn for a good price.  I am just taking up crocheting again, and found the colours and types that I wanted.  Unfortunately, they do not have much for crocheters, but I knew that going in and I still had a good experience!  Good job!

My favorite place to eat in Boston. Granted, I go here pretty regularly because it's so close to my school, but that doesn't take away from the plethora of high-quality options. Of all the reviews I have on Yelp, I would consider this review to be the most credible; I have ate almost every menu item this establishment offers. For appetizers, the onion rings are to die for. I've been to some pretty high end places that offer onion rings for twice the price (think Grille 23) and still don't live up to the flavor of the Parish onion rings. For wing enthusiasts, the Parish wings are also a must-try. They are a little expensive for the amount that you get, but these baked wings are an experience that every wing enthusiast needs to try with hearty helpings of the banana mango chutney sauce served on the side. The egg quesadilla is also delicious, but definitely more of a deep cut to be tried after you've been hooked to Parish. That's not an affront the dish, the wings and the onion rings are just that damn good! The sandwiches are the reason I keep coming back here. There are very few sandwiches I haven't tried here and even less sandwiches I don't like. My personal favorite is the Mexican Meatball. If you can handle spicy, then you have to try this on your first visit. Props to you if you can finish that sandwich. The Parish Chicken Sandwich is very good, but a little overhyped. It's delicious, but not incredibly unique. The Egg Salad Lyonnaise is another favorite of mine, and recently at that. I had stayed away from this sandwich for the longest time, as I generally despise egg salad. If you're on the same boat as me in that respect, fear not! It doesn't have the usual overpowering mayonnaise and calling it an egg salad sandwich honestly isn't even an appropriate title. The Rialto is very good, if a little less than filling in my opinion. The Eggplant Milanese is an excellent option for vegetarians. It also accomplishes the rare feat of filling my stomach (something that vegetarian dishes generally don't do for me). Honestly, after I typed that sentence I realized that I was going to run down the whole menu and that is way too TLDR. In short, try everything! The only menu items I feel lukewarm about are the Chicken Herb Sandwich and the Spicy Tuna Burger. Not bad sandwiches, but honestly didn't leave that much of an impression. Fairly easy to get a table in short order here (even on weekends) and the beer menu is EXTENSIVE. Got to go, I've just convinced myself to go to Parish.

Charged me $75 just to take a look at my car.  Recommended over $1400 worth of work so I took my car to Yost to get a second opinion.  Yost looked at my car for FREE and then fixed the problem for $210.

When my wife shops with our toddler they always walk her cart out and load her groceries in her car so she can focus her attention on our son. I can't thank them enough for going above and beyond to keep our family safe and taking something off of my wife's plate. Thank you HEB!!
This place has amazing food. I have only ordered delivery, but the food is just so great. Definitely one of the best pizza places in the area.

The original Rodeo Diner has added another diner to the family!  Same family owners; same good cooking. If you're there when Theresa makes her Hawaiian cake, be sure to have a piece... It's delicious!

I don't know what some of these other Yelpers are experiencing but we have had nothing but exceptional service and food both times we've been here.  We wondered in on Saturday about a quarter to 9pm.  We picked a table outside to enjoy the evening.  We ordered the FEAST again as it was so delicious the first time I had been craving it ever since.  This place is quickly becoming my favorite restaurant!  Nice quiet location, wonderful Service and even better food.  Do yourself a favor and give them a try you'll be glad you did.
I love this store!!! Oh and the restaurant upstairs is great place to spend a lazy Sunday. They  make great bloody marys!!!

I was worried about using U-Pack, given some of the reviews I saw, but U-Pack was the only easy part of my otherwise miserable move. I took my stuff to ABF Freight, which is an affiliate of U-Pack, and the people at ABF Freight, both in Portland and in Phoenix, where my stuff was delivered, were FANTASTIC. They were helpful, responsive, and nice. Even though I was a day late, they had my stuff to me within a few short days. The rates for U-Pack were 1/4 of the amount I would have paid to a moving company. I will use U-Pack again.

I agree with the rest of the reviews. Foodies was a mainstay of my weekends.   I gave the Rockhopper a couple of chances, hoping I'd enjoy the experience just as much.  My experiment with this place was short lived, however.  The owner was really rude every time I went in, and the staff just seemed miserable.  It was just bad energy in that place.  The service was very slow, and the food was not worth the wait.  I think that if the new owner want to salvage the biz, she's going to adjust her attitude and do some training and team building with the new staff.  BTW-You can now find me at the Muffin Shop or the Atomic on the weekends.

Love this hair salon! They have a very comfortable an relaxing environment. During any of your services they provide hand massage, they washing station has the most comfortable chairs, u get a scalp & neck massage during your wash, then an awesome blowout. Prices are reasonable considering its a non gratuity salon.
Really tasty chicken. It's succulent, savory and yummy! The tortillas were very good, as were the accompanying sauces!

Yep, worth the wait. The menu is so original, and our server Leigh was a gem.They have a pretty extensive cocktail list. I went with an apple mimosa, which was a good size. My husband had a beermosa. This was the first timeThat we were able to miss together. We arrived early on a Sunday...maybe 9:40. We were told that it would be a 45 minute wait, but we lucked out and it was about 25. They had complimentary coffee for those waiting, and some seating in the patio. There was even corn hole!The menu has a lot of yummy options. Our food took a while so the manager brought us a pineapple upside down pancake...it was so good. For my meal I had an omelette with chicken sausage. It came with hash browns and toast. I could not finish.We were sad for our time at Snooze to come to an end, but people were waiting, and we needed to move along. I loved that they did not rush us though. We'll be back.Tips: Get there early, garage parking, and you cannot see it from the street.

Great atmosphere, amazing and authentic food, and a great selection of sake with some Japanese beers on tap. There's nothing more you could ask for. You might break the bank, but your money is well spent on such delicious and quality food. I can't wait to come back and keep trying more of the menu. Also, hope you get lucky that they're doing takoyaki during your visit because it was fantastic.

First thing I did upon arrival was order a drink. Then the fried plantains caught my eye. They also caught the attention of everyone I was with and disappeared within five minutes. Heed my warning order two plates if you are expected to share. Then the group started ordering actual food, I joined in and got the lamb burgers. They ARE amazing. I finished one of them and patiently waited to ask the waitress for ketchup only to find that they didn't have any. I decided to improvise and use the sauce from the fried plantains. Lets just say I was having an intimate moment with my plate of food. The Sangria I ordered was alright, not as good as I had imagined. They just cut up a slice of lemon and put wine and ice over it. I expected chucks of actual peaches or more of a peace flavor when ordering a Peach Sangria in Georgia. We also ended up ordering a bottle of Riesling. Slightly disappointed. They need to get some Moscato up in there! I'm kind of becoming a wine snob. They don't split checks so bring cash if you are in a group. The music and crowd are pretty great. We sat next to the stage and it was loud. The DJ did a good job, people were dancing as we were leaving. I guess next time I'll pregame, sneak in a bottle of Ketchup and a change of underwear.

Very poor customer service, the cash register is kinda hidden behind a wall. It was my 1st time and I was asked if I wanted to order takeout I said yes, the woman walked away. Another woman walked in and around the corner and they took her order! I was like oh , u could have told me to order around the corner and not at the front desk area, which was the only area in sight. Have gone again service still lacking

YAY, THEY ARE BACK! The food is so delicious again. We went two weeks ago with family and we haven't stopped talking about it. We had BeeT Carpaccio, with feta and candied pecans and it so was delightful. The Arancini were crispy with just the right amount of gooey cheese. OMG, whatever you did Gustos, please do not change it again!!! Fingers crossed the old Lasagna Recipe makes a resurgence too. :) :) :)

Quick Tip: For Sunday brunch, get a bloody mary. Better yet, get one of the spicy ones. They were delicious and with a kick of fun. Another quick tip: the omelettes are HUGE. I mean, I know in the gay community size matters, but really, these omelettes were meant for two people. And the servers were too cute and serviceable.
I sat on the porch near the water and ordered Mahi Mahi as well as Oreo explosion dessert. Fantastic service, excellent food.  Have not stopped talking about it! Will be back again soon.

If you want to shop in Paris and Milan but save yourself the travel, knitwit is your place. They have an exquisite selection of womans clothing (bummer no mens) of quality that you rarely see in US stores. This is a serious boutique. Don't expect to find any brands you know. And expect to pay dear. While expensive, you will never see anyone wearing the same thing and this place is a lot cheaper than going to Europe. I had a couple long conversations with the owners visits here and I understand why some people think they are rude. They are serious clothing aficionados. This place ain't for everyone. If you are poor, don't bother. If you are over weight, you probably will not find anything that fits because this is essentially a european store. If you don't understand these last two sentences, then this store isn't for you.
It says you close at midnight tonight. Attempted to enter at 11pm and you are closed. Bummer.

Wow... With the view/atmosphere this place has, I think the beer would have to be pretty disgusting not to get a 5 star review. Oasis Brewing is probably the coolest brewery (that hasn't been one of the larger, Dogfish Head/Harpoon scales) that I've been to.First of all.. the area, Oasis, feels like is own little town although the address is Austin. It was a bit of a hike out of the city. Well worth it though. The brewery is on the 3rd floor of the complex, I guess you could call it. It has an unbelievable view of Lake Travis! We had heard that sunset was the perfect time to go and that couldn't be more true. We timed it perfectly. I would have to say this is one of the best views I have ever seen, if not THE best (seriously). Not to mention the brewery has a lot going for it! Tons of space with cool garage doors, cornhole boards, the works. Also the whole complex looks like some sort of fortress if you were viewing from the lake. The infrastructure of this thing is incredible. Oh and the beer I had, a brown ale, was good. Usually that is really important to me, but the intangibles seemed to beat out the beer this time. I hope to return one day... Soon...

I've only stepped foot in a Wal-Mart once and only because I was in desperate and quick need of sneakers. But Target is a whole 'nother story! I heart Target. It's the super hip everything you need in once place store. I dig the clothes, I dig the frames and I definitely dig the ads. From Mizrahi to Malomars, you can have a whole lot of fun here!

Meh. Food was not that great and the outdoor seating was kind of okay. We wanted to see the beer menu but they didn't have one. The waitress kind of blurted out a list of 10 beers and we had to choose one. It wasn't super cold. We ordered some sea food off of the menu and I wasn't impressed with my red snapper at all.  Overall the whole experience was just meh. Not a dinner place I guess? I haven't tried it for breakfast or brunch.

The Boyfriend and I have eaten here twice in the last 6 weeks.  The fries are really, really good.  Their cheeseburgers are okay. I'm spoiled by the great California places; In-N-Out, and Tommy's World Famous.  Frankly, The Big Carl at Carl's Jr., and even a Big Mac are better than these burgers. How can they have so many toppings and sauces but no Thousand Island-like sauce???

Writing this review while still at the restaurant with my family.   Villagio is a beautiful place.  The food is fairly good.  Carbonata appetizer is awesome, as is the bruschetta.  Main plates left something to be desired.  My meatball was not very tasty, although the fettuccini Alfredo is quite good.  Next time I would get the pizzas, I saw some coming from the kitchen and they looked great!
great location, great service, great food. One of my favorite places to go in Yaletown.

Now that I have moved away from Austin I feel I can finally let this secret out of the bag. This is the real deal for BBQ. Is this place a deluxe restaurant? Nah. Is the brisket served on Wonder Bread? Unfortunately, yes. Is it the best brisket I have ever had? Nah. What it is a couple of dudes running a little hole in the wall BBQ joint where you can get a pretty good brisket sandwich for a cheap price. (And it is saying something for this Kansas City boy to be complimenting Texas BBQ.)Over the 4 years I worked in SE Austin I hit Ray's about 10 times for lunch, and it was always consistently good food.
Great food, great atmosphere. Can't wait to come back. The ribeye & gold standard beer were fantastic. Kris is a phenomenal chef!

AMM did a great job on my Chevy Tahoe.  The quote and timeline they gave me was spot on. Per my request, they tried to find after market parts instead of using standard GM parts. But they couldn't find everything. None the less, the price they quoted was accurate.

We brought friends from Mexico there for dinner. They have a decent wine selection and the food is very good. Portions are generous so bring your appetite! It is quite loud so if you are looking for quiet and romantic, this is not the place. We had to pay for valet ($17), so heads up...Definitely will come back for a hearty Italian meal.

This restaurant just opened earlier this year on UBC campus.It's spacious and can easily host large groups with separate tables.  There's nice LCD Tv's all around the restaurant and it was a nice place to hang out and try different menu items during winter olympics and world cup soccer.I enjoy their appy items like nachos, sweet potato fries and calamari, was especially great when paired with beer and world cup soccer game at the time.  My favorite entrees are their angel hair pasta with prawns, coconut curry vegetables and the prime rib burger with garlic fries.  The vegan burger and the summer berry salad are also good vegetarian choices.  Note: they are still updating their menu often so please don't be alarmed if my recommended dishes are not available at the time of your visit.If you are at UBC and would like to go for a casual lunch/dinner or find a nice place for coffee and drinks, this place is worth checking out.
Great location! With in store seating and on the corner of a park or on the docks. Amazing smoothie selection and delicious frozen coffee! Friendly staff. Dog treat available!

Ok guys this is a good place... i'm actually (real) Italian and if I go to an Italian restaurant I have high expectation bit I have to say this is very good for the price. Pasta is not extremely overcooked or salty as it usually is in Italian-American places. We have been here twice and tried Asian and Italian and both times the taste, quality, portion size and service were extremely good. We'll be back

The atmosphere is awesome.The food is good.The tea/coffe menu is excellent.I really love the menu BUT the following is why I'm giving only  3 stars:1. They include a 20% service fee in your check which is okay by itself but then they also include tip suggestions like most places which can be deceiving since you might end up tipping twice in a not so full service place.2. They could've been better in terms of service but I guess that's sort of the theme of the place, chill and cozy...3. The Baklava was horrible, it was so old that the sweet coating was crystalised

The only downside was the 1.5 hour wait on a Sunday evening. However, in a group of three we were able to sit at the bar almost immediately.We ordered the 8 spice ling cod, the pad thai, and the seafood red curry. The cod was my personal favourite, great for people who like sweet flavours mixed with their savoury meal. The cod didn't come with any sides, but the bartender/server recommended to get a side of rice so the flavours weren't too overpowering which was a good idea. The curry was great for seafood lovers & the broth was pretty thin and soup-like compared to more traditional curries.The restaurant itself is quite small and gets packed so be sure to make a reservation to avoid long wait times!

Love it, but oh my goodness do not try to go on a Friday night at 8pm .  I could barely open the door just to get in.  I don't know how long the wait was, I went straight for the bar to see if there were any seats.  Silly me.  I did get to see the best bartender ever: David.  Sweet as can be and very accurate drink making skills!I love El Vaq for what it is.  It's quick, it's consistent, and the margarita's (Texas Gold) will knock you down if you allow them too.  I'm usually open to the offer.

Food is average, selection was a disappointment. The reviews sounded like it was much more than a fast food burger joint. Over priced food and servers were slow, but did get the start of the food quickly had to wait forever for shake at 2 pm, no rush so would have expected much better service.
Two dollar mimosas on Sundays and friendly bartenders always fun when we watch the charger games on Sundays

Dumplings here are delish! The service was decent too. The chilli wontons and pork/chive dumplings were tasty. Note: if it's raining outside (which it often is in this town) the floors are very slippery. I stepped in and almost bailed on the tiles, then I watched a few others do the same.

Another gem in the North End. Their service and food is fantastic- desserts on the other hand are forgettable.  I tasted everyones dish that I was with at Prezza and each was different and well done. I recommend the wood grilled squid for and potato gnocchi bolognese! Great meal at Prezza. I especially like the fact that it is tucked away off Hanover St- perfect for date night.

I haven't been to the dentist in years, and I'm glad I found this one! They were able to schedule me right away. The place was very clean and smelled very nice. The staff were welcoming and answered all the questions I had- they were very transparent about the billing.
